::: {.g-col-10 .g-col-lg-10 .welcome-text .sand-background style="padding: 2px; text-align: left;"}

Philosophy for the Real World, the Saleno Center for Human Flourishing is an academic research organization dedicated to understanding how the art we consume shapes who we become.

* Art's capacity to ignite ethical reflection on our deepest bonds—family, friendship, love—and the meaningful paths toward union with God.
* Interactive Ethics, how video games create moral dilemmas that force players to confront their values in ways traditional philosophy cannot.
* Music & Moral Identity, how artists use narrative to help listeners process emotions and imagine ethical commitments.
* Aesthetic Sentimentalism, bridging aesthetics and ethics to understand how beauty, emotion, and moral knowledge intertwine in popular art forms.

Join us as we bridge philosophy, technology, and art to nurture a deeper connection with God and with each other.

If you are a someone working at the intersection of music, games and other aspects of popculture and ethics, or a professional game designer working on a game that focuses on ethical play, you are welcome to contribute to this site. I am particularly looking for:

* Links to papers (past or present) on games and ethics,
* Reviews of games with interesting approaches to ethical play,
* Reviews of books on games and ethics,
* Announcements of events (conferences, workshops etc) related to games and ethics.
